UPSSSC Assistant Boring Technician Final Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Final answer key for the recruitment of Assistant Boring Technician posts on the official website of UPSSSC. This recruitment was released for 402 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Assistant Boring Technician Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 15 April 2026, to 05 May 2026. The online examination was held on 12 July 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPSSSC Assistant Boring Technician Answer Key 2026 from the link given below..
